title: M. Nagaraj v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: M. Nagaraj v. Union of India, (2006) 8 SCC 212
content.holding: Upheld 77th, 81st, 82nd, and 85th Amendments for SC/ST promotion reservations, subject to quantifiable data on backwardness, inadequacy, and administrative efficiency.
content.relevance: Validation of promotion reservations and the triple data test.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 61 of 2002; 2006 INSC 734; (2006) 8 SCC 212.
